# Provenance

Consolidated provenance metadata for any entity — replaces the 5-7 scattered provenance fields that were previously repeated on every entity. Tracks how the data was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it

Source: [`v3/common/provenance.json`](../../../v3/common/provenance.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/common/provenance.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | one of `import`, `manual`, `ai_generated` | | How this entity's data was originally created |
| `confidence` | `number` | | Overall confidence score for this entity's data (0.0 = no confidence, 1.0 = fully verified) |
| `importSourceId` | `string` | | References importSources[].id on the root document — identifies which import source produced this entity's data. Plain string, not UUID |
| `aiProvenance` | [AiProvenance](ai-provenance.md) | | AI provenance metadata — which AI model produced this data and whether a human has verified it |
| `humanVerdict` | one of `approved`, `rejected`, `modified`, `pending_review` | | Human review verdict on AI-generated or imported data |
| `rejectionReason` | `string` | | Reason for rejecting or modifying data |
| `verdictAt` | `string` (date-time) | | When the human verdict was recorded |
| `agentTaskId` | `string` | | ID of the agent task that created or modified this entity — links to the agent orchestration system |
